content.title: Trump ousts Pam Bondi as attorney general - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Jeremy Roebuck, Natalie Allison, Emily Davies and Perry SteinPresident Donald Trump announced Thursday that he was ousting Pam Bondi as attorney general, ending a tumultuous 14-month tenure in which she transformed the Justice Department into a tool for avenging the president’s grievances but frustrated him with her struggles to prosecute his enemies and her handling of files related to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.What readers are sayingThe comments reflect a mix of sarcasm, criticism, and speculation regarding Pam Bondi's firing as Attorney General by President Trump. Many commenters express skepticism about Trump's loyalty and decision-making, suggesting Bondi was dismissed for not being sufficiently compliant... Show moreThis summary is AI-generated.
